newsitem.title: USA: MAIC Holdings renamed Medical Assurance.
newsitem.headline: MAIC Holdings renamed Medical Assurance.

text.p: MAIC Holdings Inc said on Friday that it would change its name to Medical Assurance Inc, effective June 1.
"The name change is an integral part of our plans to create a national identity for our holding company and our insurance subsidiaries," said Frank O'Neil, senior vice president of the company.
Medical Assurance Inc will retain MAI as its trading symbol on the New York Stock Exchange when trading begins under the new name on June 2, the company added.
